title: Comprehensive Benchmarking of Deep Learning Architectures for Lung Cancer Histopathology
abstract: arXiv:2608.15915v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, while histopathological diagnosis is often affected by inter-observer variability and the substantial workload associated with manual slide examination. Although deep learning has shown considerable potential in computational pathology, comprehensive benchmarks that integrate tissue classification and region segmentation within a unified analytical framework remain limited. This study presents a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class tissue classification and pixel-level histopathological region segmentation, accompanied by a systematic comparison of state-of-the-art architectures at each stage. For tissue classification, six models, a custom convolutional neural network, VGG16, DenseNet, MobileNetV3, a custom Vision Transformer, and YOLO11, are evaluated on a combined dataset of 39,000 images derived from LC25000 and LungHist700. translated_title: 深度学习架构在肺癌组织病理学中的综合基准测试
translated_abstract: 肺癌仍是全球癌症相关死亡的主要原因，而组织病理学诊断常受观察者间差异和手动切片检查繁重工作量的影响。尽管深度学习在计算病理学中展现出巨大潜力，但在统一分析框架内整合组织分类和区域分割的综合基准测试仍然有限。本研究提出了一种两阶段深度学习框架，用于多类组织分类和像素级组织病理区域分割，并对每个阶段的最先进架构进行了系统性比较。在组织分类方面，六种模型——自定义卷积神经网络、VGG16、DenseNet、MobileNetV3、自定义视觉Transformer和YOLO11——在来自LC25000和LungHist700的组合数据集（包含39,000张图像）上进行了评估。这些模型区分了不同的组织类型。
tldr: 本研究提出并基准测试了一个两阶段深度学习框架，用于肺癌组织病理学的多类分类和区域分割，系统比较了六种先进架构在统一分析框架下的性能。
en_tdlr: This study proposes and benchmarks a two-stage deep learning framework for multi-class classification and region segmentation in lung cancer histopathology, systematically comparing six state-of-the-art architectures within a unified analytical framework.
